source_text: The mechanism underlying this protection stems from the removal of the foreskin, which harbors Langerhans cells susceptible to HIV entry and provides a moist environment conducive to viral persistence during heterosexual intercourse, thereby diminishing the biological vulnerability to infection via causal pathways independent of behavioral changes. [6]
